source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / ASPIRE Project (IFAD-funded) - "Climate Resilient Banana Growing Technique" (ផលិតកម្មដំណាំចេកដែលធន់ទៅនឹងការប្រែប្រួលអាកាសធាតុ), November 2018
text: Like the STEER guide covering similar ground (see Source A's planting-calendar entry), this booklet includes a seasonal table linking recommended planting timing to expected harvest timing and market demand periods, so that farmers can plan planting dates with an eye toward having bunches ready when demand - and price - are more favorable.
